verdict.rationale: Entrust documents official first-party mobile SDKs for iOS, Android and React Native, initialized via SDK tokens returned from workflow runs, so developers can build verification capture against them. The evidence covers only front-end capture SDKs, with Flutter still unreleased, and does not show backend or server-side client libraries. missing for 10: evidenced backend/server-side SDKs (e.g., Node/Python/Java API client libraries), an explicit web SDK, a released Flutter SDK, SDK reference depth and versioning details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: As a direct replacement to the Onfido Smart Capture SDKs, a new set of mobile SDKs is now available for iOS, Android and React Native
with our new Flutter SDK to be released later in 2026
SDK tokens are essential for authenticating and initializing the Entrust IDV SDKs
create a workflow run (returns an SDK token) → collect captures via SDK
